about_the_game:
Realtime Tactical Action

  • Action RTS, Realtime Tactics Genre

  • Tactical pause is possible

  • Switch between two viewpoints: free view and top view

  • Create a tactical plan including the movement path, direction of alert, target designation, and action execution of units.

Gameplay driven by tactical elements

The success of the mission rests on your shoulders.

As the commander, you fight with your mind rather than participating directly in combat.

The outcome can vary greatly depending on the decisions you make.

Identify the enemy's position and devise a tactical plan to break through.

  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 Ti
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04 or Higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen5
